method.selection: strict local task markdown filter: task title/file indicates evaluation/learning/absorption/source-review and body contains repo/GitHub/open-source/source evidence; product tasks like UVISA/Lark are excluded unless explicitly source-review
method.classification: keyword-assisted first-pass mapping; registry is canonical projection, original task notes remain historical SSOT
method.non_goal: does not mark unfinished implementation tasks done; does not execute third-party repos

long_term_stable_solution.ssot: module-registry.json is the machine-readable projection; original task markdown remains historical SSOT; open-source-absorption-modules.md is the human operating map
long_term_stable_solution.loop: source review -> transferable pattern -> module mapping -> safety gate -> minimal verifiable slice -> taskpool proof -> skill/doc/code/dashboard landing
long_term_stable_solution.verification: verify_registry.py checks schema, module count, unique ids, referenced task paths, and primary counts; future code changes must add focused tests/readback per module
long_term_stable_solution.governance: new external repo lessons enter as module candidates first; promotion to skill/code requires evidence and rollback boundary; dashboard remains read-only unless taskpool gate authorizes writes
long_term_stable_solution.module_count_decision: Canonical top-level modules stay at 18; Data Agent/MLOps is treated as a cross-domain submodule under Evidence Retrieval and Vision/Media to avoid top-level fragmentation.
